thread:
incident-bot: Paging on-call: GPU pool 'eu-gpu-pool-2' exceeded soft capacity (queue growth > 90%) for model v14.1. Auto-scale attempts failing: reached max nodes (24). Trigger: 2026-03-15 02:34 UTC.

Alex SRE: acked — I'm on it, looking at the autoscaler logs and GPU queue metrics.

Priya ML: fyi, we pushed v14.1 earlier with tokenizer changes + slightly different KV layout. We saw a perf validation pass but not at high QPS. Could be more tokens per request.

Marco Runtime: +1, I'm seeing a spike in per-session KV entries and average ctx len. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/model-v14.1?orgId=1

Alex SRE: current numbers — QPS steady, tail latency up and queued requests > 6k across pool. Avg ctx length jumped from ~1.1k -> ~3.6k tokens in the last 30m. KV-cache footprint per pod ~3.8GB -> 9.6GB.

Dana ProdSupport: any customer impact yet? jen CS, can you triage top tenants?

jen CS: early list: org-phi (chat assistant), partner-beta (search), two internal trials. Some error reports about 502 / longer than usual responses. I'm pulling request logs now.

Liam Infra: autoscaler logs show repeated scale-ups but nodes stay in Pending due to GPU driver init timing + scheduler backpressure. AWS quota is fine but kube-scheduler can't place pods — some nodes hit ephemeral disk pressure taints.

Marco Runtime: looks like pods are stuck in Init: Downloading weights for v14.1 and KV warmup step is long — warmup causes ephemeral storage and memory pressure. That combined with larger KV cache means each pod takes longer to become Ready. Autoscaler thinks it's still provisioning but pool can't keep up.

Alex SRE: mitigation plan (short): 1) pause v14.1 rollout 2) route new traffic to v13 fallback 3) reduce concurrency/disable long KV warmup on v14.1 copies 4) add throttling rule for heavy contexts 5) if needed, temporarily raise autoscale max to 30 while we remediate.

Priya ML: Recommend we revert tokenizer change from v14.1 -> v14.0 tokenization for now. That should reduce average token expansion. Can we pin traffic to v13 immediately and rollback v14.1?

Marco Runtime: we can patch routing rules. Running canary rollback now:
```bash
# route traffic away from v14.1 to v13 fallback
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/routes/patch" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"v14.1","action":"drain","duration":"15m","fallback":"v13"}'
```

incident-bot: Action queued: route_draining(v14.1) initiated by Marco Runtime @2361234720.

Alex SRE: patch applied, new requests are flowing to v13. Early signs: queue length dropping in eu-gpu-pool-2 from 6k -> 3.5k in 8m. Keep observing.

jen CS: org-phi reports reduced throughput — they saw partial failures; I'm sending an update: "We are routing you to a stable model variant while we investigate increased load; ETA 2h for full resolution."

Dana ProdSupport: thanks. Marking as "customer-impact: degraded". Please tag any orgs that request SLA credits.

Priya ML: To prevent recurrence, we'll prepare a v14.1 patch to revert tokenizer tweak and add a KV eviction policy that caps per-session entries. That should drop KV usage ~40%. ETA for patch: 3h.

Marco Runtime: also implementing a fast path: when avg ctx_len > 2.5k, automatically enable prefix-KV eviction and force smaller generation batch sizes. Patching runtime config now:
```yaml
runtime_config:
  prefix_kv_eviction: auto
  eviction_threshold_tokens: 2500
  max_generation_batch: 8
```
Applying to pool eu-gpu-pool-2.

Liam Infra: I've temporarily increased autoscaler max_nodes to 30 to give us headroom; note: this is emergency override and will be reverted when stable. Cloud quota confirmed. Also cleaning up nodes with disk pressure taints.

Alex SRE: note — autoscaler was failing earlier because some node init hooks pulled large OCI layers concurrently; added serialized init to avoid thrash. Changing the init concurrency to 2 for now.

Marco Runtime: runtime patch applied to 40% of nodes. Observing KV cache per-pod dropping 20% already. Queue now 1.2k. Latency stabilizing.

jen CS: updated affected customers: org-phi, partner-beta, internal-trial-3. Communicated mitigation and asked for logs. No SLA credit requests yet.

Dana ProdSupport: handoff: Alex will escalate to next on-call (Priya) at shift change in 40m. Document actions taken and follow-up tasks.

Alex SRE: handoff notes -> ongoing: watch queue length, confirm rollback of v14.1 tokenizer or patch, keep autoscaler override until pool stable, reconcile any pending customer support tickets.

Priya ML: taking over monitoring. Also we'll run load test with reverted tokenizer in staging and measure tokens/request distribution.

Marco Runtime: follow-up items I'll own: add runtime metric for per-session KV entries, add alert when average ctx > 2000 for 5m, and add init-hook telemetry for pod startup time.

Liam Infra: follow-up: audit node init scripts and reduce concurrent OCI downloads, and schedule node housekeeping to avoid disk pressure during scale events.

jen CS: I'll compile incident summary and impacted customers list for the postmortem and send out customer-facing note draft by EOD.

Dana ProdSupport: current status: mitigated -> routing to v13 + runtime evictions in place + autoscale headroom. Customer impact: degraded for ~45m, now improving. We'll keep this open until v14.1 is fully patched or rolled back.

Alex SRE: closing urgent page but keeping thread live for post-incident work. Thanks team. :heart:

(automated) incident-bot: Incident status updated to "mitigated" at 2361247400.
